mapper.select: SELECT id, patient_id, has_image, has_medical_record, has_lab_result, diagnosis_status, has_diagnosis_report, first_image_upload_time, last_diagnosis_time, report_generate_time, doctor_audit_time, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM medical_patient_diagnosis WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medical_patient_diagnosis (patient_id, has_image, has_medical_record, has_lab_result, diagnosis_status, has_diagnosis_report, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{hasImage}, #{hasMedicalRecord}, #{hasLabResult}, #{diagnosisStatus}, #{hasDiagnosisReport}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE medical_patient_diagnosis SET has_image = IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chest_xray c WHERE c.patient_id = #{patientId}) > 0, 1, 0), has_medical_record = IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_record r WHERE r.patient_id = #{patientId}) > 0, 1, 0), has_lab_result = IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_lab_results l WHERE l.patient_id = #{patientId} AND (l.is_deleted = 0 OR l.is_deleted IS NULL)) > 0, 1, 0), first_image_upload_time = (SELECT MIN(c.create_time) FROM chest_xray c WHERE c.patient_id = #{patientId}), update_time = NOW() WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL)

UPDATE medical_patient_diagnosis SET has_image = IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chest_xray c WHERE c.patient_id = #{patientId}) > 0, 1, 0), has_medical_record = IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_record r WHERE r.patient_id = #{patientId}) > 0, 1, 0), has_lab_result = IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_lab_results l WHERE l.patient_id = #{patientId} AND (l.is_deleted = 0 OR l.is_deleted IS NULL)) > 0, 1, 0), first_image_upload_time = (SELECT MIN(c.create_time) FROM chest_xray c WHERE c.patient_id = #{patientId}), diagnosis_status = CASE WHEN diagnosis_status < 2 THEN 2 ELSE diagnosis_status END, last_diagnosis_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL)

UPDATE medical_patient_diagnosis SET has_diagnosis_report = 1, diagnosis_status = 4, report_generate_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL)
